jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축인허가 기본개요 lane `building-permit-basis-outline` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0356): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_basis_outline already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed permits' rows and a removal marker per vanished permit (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.
